protocol: X34 context_probe: two fixed held-out windows per length, store reset per window, full-position NLL, 128-token NLL bins, all 24 head occupancy/pressure profiles; peak/pressure aggregated as max over the two windows, means as window means.

base_lm.protocol_limit: Historical X34 B8 receipts, not batch-matched X40 B64; lengths beyond 4096 were never run and remain missing.

tape_lm.protocol_limit: Historical X34 B8 receipts, not batch-matched X40 B64; lengths beyond 4096 were never run and remain missing.

notes: Decay is graceful, not cliff-like: 8192/512 PPL ratio 1.6121 vs X34 base_lm 4096/512 ratio 4.660 (6.381 -> 29.738) and tape_lm 4.501 (6.515 -> 29.322); X34 arms were never measured at 8192.
All six gates stayed open at sigmoid(2)=0.88080 throughout; every nonpadding token had a write opportunity in every block.

Peak occupancy is block-invariant for heads 1-3 (identical integers in all six blocks at every length) and near-invariant for head 0 (62-64 of 64): the always-enable frozen gate plus shared head geometry, not learned per-block selectivity, sets occupancy.

At 8x training length the store saturates: heads 2 and 3 are pinned at their budgets (736/1472) with R-CAP write refusal fractions 0.2812 and 0.6406 respectively; head 3 refuses 64% of write requests at T8192.
